title: Synthetic example: coverage audit misses idempotency despite a passing approval test

expected.content: Q06 should mark idempotent approval as uncovered when tests never retry the same transition and never assert duplicate audit prevention.

actual.content: The audit treated a single happy-path approval assertion as enough for the idempotency requirement.

lesson: Do not mark idempotency covered unless the test repeats the same command and asserts unchanged side effects such as audit rows and notifications.
